title: Definition Pin
description: Seller-authored integrity pin over one third-party-published definition that a proposal's commercial_terms reference: a publisher-catalog format option, publisher-catalog placement, adagents.json collection, or data-provider signal. content_digest is the lowercase-hex SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 (JCS) serialization of the kind's closed projection of the published entry, defined normatively in docs/media-buy/specification.mdx#definition-pins. Pins live inside commercial_terms, so terms_digest covers the pin but not the definition it names: a published definition can change while terms_digest still verifies, and re-verifying the pin is what detects it. Request inputs never carry pins.

verifier_constraints.pin_projection: content_digest is computed over the published entry minus its kind's exclusion list, with the kind's named set arrays de-duplicated and sorted by JCS bytes

reference.description: Closed canonical identity of the pinned definition. Only the identity members below are permitted, so the same definition always has one reference value and pins are unique by (ref_kind, reference).

content_digest.description: Lowercase-hex SHA-256 of the UTF-8 RFC 8785 serialization of the projected published entry. No algorithm prefix.

source_version.description: Opaque version label of the source document the seller resolved when it computed content_digest, such as the document's catalog_etag. Informational and never dereferenced: verification compares content_digest, never source_version. It MUST NOT contain URLs, credentials, or fetch detail.
